acceptance_predicates.description: A clean clone launches the TUI with dev as the default channel using bounded temporary state.
Channel selection persists across restart and upgrade with provenance intact.
Tamper, partial-install, timeout, and rollback faults return bounded typed diagnostics and clean state.
Human-readable output is default and --json remains machine-readable.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and key management never block.

definition_of_done: Disposable exact-head TUI/ASB smoke passes with a digest-bound receipt.
Independent review and required hosted checks are green.
